name: DashCore
description: An Android64 performance diagnostics toolkit for Geometry Dash. DashCore measures gameplay update and render costs, inspects the live level scene graph, and validates a Bismuth-inspired GLES compute visibility mask. Experimental live render culling is locked off while object coverage and bounds are verified.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked)
experimental-render-culling.description: Temporarily inactive in DashCore 0.7.2. Live object hiding is hard-disabled for safety while scene traversal and object bounds are validated. The setting is retained for compatibility.
